Build your own

Write a new skill

Every skill is a small Rust crate implementing the Skill trait - list your tools, handle the calls, register it. No plugin runtime, no sandboxing to fight: it's a normal crate in the workspace, like otto-skill-notify. See docs/SKILLS.md in the repo for a full walkthrough with a working example.

Settings

Credentials are stored in your OS keychain - never in a plaintext file. Leave a field blank to keep its current value.
